topic: Direct Speech to Speech Translation: A Review
topic_definition: Stage 1 observable projection of the original paper's eligibility. Use title and abstract evidence to judge whether the study focuses on direct or end-to-end Speech-to-Speech Translation (S2ST), especially neural S2ST that avoids intermediate text representations.
summary: Stage 1 title/abstract projection of source-faithful Stage 2 criteria; publication-time filtering is handled by cutoff_jsons/2503.04799.json.

summary_topics.description: Direct Speech to Speech Translation: A Review

required.criterion: Title/abstract indicates Speech-to-Speech Translation, S2ST, direct speech translation, end-to-end speech translation, speech-unit translation, Translatotron, UnitY, or direct neural speech translation.
Observable task signal links speech input to speech output translation rather than text-only machine translation, ASR-only, TTS-only, or audio-only processing.
When direct S2ST fit is plausible but experiment sufficiency, dataset currency, or direct-vs-cascade details are incomplete in title/abstract, keep maybe and defer final confirmation to Stage 2.

exclusion_criteria.criterion: Title/abstract clearly indicates cascade speech translation using intermediate text representations, such as ASR plus MT plus TTS, with no direct S2ST focus.
Title/abstract clearly indicates text-only machine translation, ASR-only speech-to-text, TTS-only text-to-speech, or audio-only processing without S2ST.
